items.question: What technologies do you specialize in?
items.answer: I specialize in Next.js, React, TypeScript, and modern web technologies. I also work with Firebase, Supabase, and various backend-as-a-service platforms.

items.question: Are you available for freelance work?
items.answer: Yes, I'm available for freelance projects. Feel free to reach out through the contact form to discuss your project requirements.

items.question: Can I see your previous work?
items.answer: Absolutely! Check out the projects section above to see examples of my recent work, including full-stack applications, landing pages, and interactive web experiences.

items.question: Do you work with international clients?
items.answer: Yes, I work with clients worldwide. My portfolio is available in both English and Arabic to serve a diverse audience.
